meta.name: json-canvas
meta.description: Create and edit JSON Canvas files (.canvas) with nodes, edges, groups, and connections. Use when working with .canvas files, creating visual canvases, mind maps, flowcharts, or when the user mentions Canvas files in Obsidian.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和编辑 JSON Canvas 文件，构建可视化画布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Obsidian 中创建和编辑 .canvas 文件
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit JSON Canvas files for visual canvases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create and edit .canvas files in Obsidian

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能创建和编辑 JSON Canvas 文件（.canvas），包括添加文字、文件、链接、分组节点，以及用连线连接它们，并支持颜色和标签。
howto.when: 当用户提到 .canvas 文件、Obsidian 画布、思维导图、流程图，或要求创建可视化画布时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个思维导图，主题是项目计划。
在这个画布上添加一个文件节点，指向 Notes/meeting.md。
say.note: Claude 会在已有画布中插入文件节点。

say.text: 把两个节点用箭头连起来，标签写“依赖”。
say.note: Claude 会添加一条带标签的边。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create and edit JSON Canvas files (.canvas), including adding text, file, link, and group nodes, connecting them with edges, and supporting colors and labels.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions .canvas files, Obsidian Canvas, mind maps, flowcharts, or asks to create a visual canvas.

say_en.text: Create a mind map about project plan.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a .canvas file with nodes and edges.

say_en.text: Add a file node pointing to Notes/meeting.md.
say_en.note: Claude will insert a file node into the existing canvas.

say_en.text: Connect two nodes with an arrow labeled 'depends on'.
say_en.note: Claude will add an edge with a label.
